mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) predicts positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns, as it indicates an accommodative monetary policy environment that lowers discount rates for equity valuation.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) predicts negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns, as it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and dampens equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) above their 3-month moving averages predicts positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns, as it signals robust consumer and housing demand driving corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: The joint signal (RSAFS and HOUST both above 3-month MA) fails to predict positive returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) predicts negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns, as it reflects economic weakness and reduced consumer spending power, leading to lower corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 0.5% growth rate predicts positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns, as it indicates strengthening manufacturing activity and economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with INDPRO monthly growth > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 600.0 thousand units (HOUST > 600.0) predicts positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns, as it signals strong residential construction activity and consumer confidence, boosting economic growth and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 600.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annualized) predicts negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns, as it indicates a restrictive monetary policy amid persistent inflation, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations.
regime_hint: high inflation and tight monetary policy
failure_condition: The joint signal (FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a recession (GDPC1 growth < 0.0%), a rising industrial production (INDPRO monthly growth > 0.5%) predicts positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns, as it signals the start of economic recovery and improved corporate outlook.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 growth < 0.0% and INDPRO monthly growth > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
